Idempotently acknowledges the current audience marker for this account. Stale markers return 409. Saving changed visible content, showing a hidden introduction, or explicitly repeating it advances the marker and shows it on the next section visit. Unchanged saves and saves while hidden preserve acknowledgments. Hiding retains the saved content and returns no introduction.

request.description: quest_cover_v2 requires thumb (560×840, <=512 KiB) and display (840×1260, <=512 KiB), and accepts optional original (uncropped, aspect preserved, <=3000×3000, <=4 MiB). Each cover file contains name, mime=image/webp and bytes. quest_instruction_image accepts thumb (<=480×480, <=512 KiB) and display (<=2000×2000, <=4 MiB) with preserved aspect ratio: legacy WebP files contain name, mime and bytes; AVIF files additionally require positive integer width/height and a lowercase 64-character SHA-256 checksum. AVIF contents, dimensions, bytes and checksum are verified before completion. Duplicate or unknown variants are rejected. Legacy WebP clients remain supported.

request.description: For content_version>=7, platform_account is conditionally required and must be nonblank after trimming for published service identities and legacy completion forms that use usernames. Missing usernames are rejected before side effects. Explicitly unscoped publications and earlier client versions retain their existing protocol; see QuestEvidence.

routes.description: Content v10 supports explicit identity.version=2: automatic authenticated Questfall identity and screenshot/url without a source account. Individual result links are single-use per quest, even after rejection or republication; exact idempotent replay does not create another submission. Response format 2 is the only supported format and the default when response_version is omitted. Explicit unsupported versions are rejected before the operation.

Claim one Common Lootbox only with an empty eligible queue, >90% lifetime consensus match and at least 50 newly resolved regular cases since the last successful claim. Initial checkpoint is zero. Claim advances checkpoint to the current resolved count; replaying an old checkpoint returns its existing receipt.

Appeals require the current decision case_id. Current clients send response_version:2 and an 8–128 character idempotency_key. During the App 0.5.43 rollout, requests omitting both response_version and idempotency_key use a server key scoped to the authenticated actor and decision, so transport retries cannot charge twice. An explicit response_version:2 still requires the key; invalid or empty keys are rejected. All responses use format 2 with entity effects. Author quest details remain restricted to authorized space members; appeal permissions and financial terms are unchanged. Unsupported explicit response versions are rejected before the operation.

Modern requests provide ingredient_ids, expected_updated, expected_cost and idempotency_key from the quote. Legacy ingredientId-only requests remain valid only for a two-potion recipe. Changed quantities require a fresh confirmation; no extra items are selected silently.

Version-only reads keep a short cache. When keys and the current version are supplied, published artwork metadata can be cached for one day in browsers and 30 days at the CDN; a publication increments the version and changes the URL.
Load a published article by its permanent title slug or legacy record ID.

Current messages referenced by shared pins or the verified viewer personal pins. Guest responses contain no account preferences. Hidden applies only to the shared source; the preference persists across shared unpin and repin. Never cached.
Idempotently set the verified viewer personal pin state. The server determines the account. Shared pins and permanent hiding are unchanged.

Permanently hide the shared source of this message for the verified viewer. Optional boolean unpin_personal defaults to false; true also removes the viewer personal pin in the same transaction. Shared pins and other accounts are unchanged. Hiding survives message edits and shared unpin/repin; there is no restore operation.
Idempotently set the shared pin state using the existing admin guard, independent of the public team badge. Personal pins and hiding are unchanged. Changed states are audited transactionally.

Read recent messages, a page before a cursor, or a bounded window around a message. Guests can read the full community history without personal reaction state. before and around are mutually exclusive; has_newer is returned for around windows.

Search literal substrings in message text or current public author names. q is trimmed and accepts 3–120 Unicode characters. Results are newest first (created, id descending), limit defaults to 25 and is capped at 50. before is the opaque next cursor and remains valid if its message is deleted.
view accepts attention (unread updates or personal unclaimed rewards), all (legacy default), or claimable. Counters count cards once across all pages.

Manual chat translation languages and shared provider availability. With a configured key, availability starts optimistic; inference failures disable new translations until a scheduled recovery probe succeeds. Healthy service never triggers probes. Reading settings performs no inference and exposes no provider credentials or billing details.

Translate either an existing message (message and its edited revision) or an unsent draft (text, optional mentions), never both. Verified readers may translate messages; draft translation enforces chat writing permissions. Text limit 2000 UTF-16 code units; draft output also max 2000, reading output max 8000. No chat message or translation is persisted. Mentions and URLs are preserved; translated mention offsets refer to output text. Server translates the current message, rejects stale revisions and limits each user to 20 requests/minute.

Private verified-user mention search. A non-empty q searches a literal name prefix, up to 64 characters; returns at most four verified, unrestricted users ordered by name and id. Empty q returns no users.

request.description: Optional gif uses ChatGif. A message must contain text, images or a GIF; edits preserve its media.

routes.description: Publish an ephemeral typing presence update to verified chat subscribers. active pulses are rate-limited per user, expire after eight seconds and are never persisted; inactive updates end only the supplied browser session.
Find the oldest unread mention, reply or everyone announcement for the current user without marking it read.

Compatibility surface for already deployed App clients and open tabs. Reporting keeps its verified-account, idempotent receipt and saved-evidence behavior while new clients use team moderation. Retire only after producer migration and a separate compatibility review.

filter accepts active (open and confirmed, for older clients), open, confirmed, closed, rejected, or hidden. Hidden is admin only. Only accessible feedback is returned. Optional audience is an exact list filter applied before pagination. Status counts exclude hidden records and are scoped to that audience; counts.mine spans every audience and status owned by the viewer. Optional audience_counts contains Open totals for the viewer's permitted reader groups, independent of the selected audience, status, Mine filter and pagination.

award_gold is optional and accepts whole numbers from 0 to 1000000 for the first accepted decision. Zero or omission saves the decision without awarding Gold. A later status change does not award Gold again.

Audience defaults to public. Every verified author may submit a public or team-only bug report; the author retains access to their own private report. Admins and users with the matching internal role may also create reports for the corresponding internal audiences. Reader access is independent of creation permission.
Only the report author can edit title, description, steps, expected, actual, area, os, browser, or version. The expected_value must match the current field; steps and their expected_value are arrays.
include_updates=true merges team decision messages into chronological comment pagination. Omitted keeps the ordinary-comments-only response.

One package may reuse an open order. Every accepted request key is durably associated with the returned order, including after fulfillment; replay cannot create a new order.

Weekly inviter standings with public identities, aggregate referral activity, pool shares and allocated Gold estimates. Includes unranked zero-score inviters without exposing their individual referrals or reward histories. own=true locates the viewer's page; search preserves global ranks.

Merge the server-quoted number of distinct owned Gems into one next-rarity Gem. ingredient_ids contains every additional ID. The current recipe, item revision and exact cost are rechecked before atomic spending.

Public weekly pool, points chart and leaderboard. With an authenticated session, includes the viewer's position, wallet and points. Guests receive a null position, zero wallet and own metrics, and no rows marked own. Gold mutations still require authentication.
Current live Daily configuration and personal UTC-day progress. Admin saves apply immediately. Disabled tasks are hidden; their earned rewards still settle after the day ends.

UTC daily tasks. Claim identifies a day and opaque stable reward key. Earned rewards retain their original bundle across edits or disabling; replay returns the same award without another payment.

Merge the server-quoted number of distinct owned Dice into one next-rarity Dice. ingredient_ids contains every additional ID. The current recipe, item revision and exact cost are rechecked before atomic spending.

Active page-control identities: period categories use their ISO period as id; referral uses the invited player id; other objects use their record id. Space subscriptions are limited to the user's Author Spaces and author teams; foreign space observations and moderation work bonuses are retired.

Track accessible objects individually, even when auto-add is disabled. Use object record IDs, invited player ID for referral, and ISO week or season keys for mining_week, mining_season, gem_week and referral_reward. Personal completions, orders and Freezing positions are owner-only. Space observation requires ownership or author-team membership; foreign spaces return 404. Legacy team quest requests follow their Author Space.

Claim only this card’s reward. Optional payout_id binds a personal reward request to the displayed receipt; it must belong to the card and user. Welcome cards require quest_id for an initial request to bind the displayed Welcome reward. Retries remain bound to the same reward after the card advances to the next week or Welcome quest.

Anonymous compact snapshots (32 KiB maximum); accepted_revision is idempotent. Visit writes require the per-visit write_key. Server assigns IP, country and account linkage; telemetry failures do not block auth.

Changes the readership of the entire existing history. Uses FeedbackAudience. Author always retains access; Readership is hierarchical: Admins include Team and Founders; Team includes Founders (owner). Atomic version check, subscription revocation and audit; 409 leaves all data unchanged.
